description:
Gerente de Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos a Brava Energia, a Companhia independente de óleo e gás mais diversificada do Brasil.

Temos operações em terra e mar, do upstream ao downstream, com mais de mil colaboradores em nossa força de trabalho. Oferecemos amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira, em um ambiente dinâmico, focado em resultados e alta performance. Estamos constantemente aplicando a experiência do nosso time para maximizar nossa produção, transformando O&G em valor para o Brasil.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão do cargo:

Liderar a implementação de estratégias e programas de segurança ocupacional, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as operações na terra e no mar.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar políticas e procedimentos de segurança específicos para operações onshore e offshore, alinhados com as regulamentações e padrões da empresa.
  • Desenvolver e implementar medidas preventivas e corretivas para mitigar riscos ocupacionais identificados, assegurando a segurança de todos os trabalhadores onshore e offshore.
  • Projetar e coordenar programas de treinamento em segurança para todas as equipes onshore e offshore, abordando tópicos como resposta a emergências, procedimentos de evacuação, e uso de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e coletiva (EPCs).
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores-chave de segurança onshore e offshore, como taxas de incidentes, acidentes, e quase acidentes, utilizando esses dados para identificar tendências e áreas de melhoria.
  • Liderar investigações de incidentes de segurança onshore e offshore, identificando causas raiz e desenvolvendo planos de ação corretivos e preventivos para evitar recorrências.
  • Garantir a implementação eficaz das ações corretivas e comunicar os aprendizados com todas as partes interessadas.
  • Garantir que todas as operações onshore e offshore estejam em conformidade com as normas locais e internacionais de segurança e saúde ocupacional, incluindo as regulamentações da ANP e normas da OGP.
  • Supervisionar o uso adequado de EPIs e EPCs, garantindo que todos os equipamentos sejam de qualidade e estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança.
  • Estabelecer e manter relações com autoridades regulatórias, organizações da indústria e prestadores de serviços para compartilhar melhores práticas e garantir a conformidade com as normas de segurança.
  • Formação com Superior completo em Engenharia, Segurança do Trabalho, Saúde Ocupacional ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em funções relacionadas à saúde e segurança ocupacional, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais ou de grande porte.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a área:

A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.

Diversidade:

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
  • Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;

  • Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
  • Conhecimento emdesenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;

  • Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;

  • Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
  • Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.

title: Medico Neuropediatra Diarista- Hospital Cardoso Fontes
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia .

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável pelo atendimento especializado a crianças e adolescentes com distúrbios neurológicos, atuando no diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de condições que afetam o desenvolvimento do sistema nervoso central e periférico. Atua em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a reabilitação e melhoria da qualidade de vida dos pacientes.

Principais Atividades
  • Realizar consultas ambulatoriais e hospitalares com enfoque neurológico pediátrico.
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças como epilepsia, paralisia cerebral, autismo, TDAH, distúrbios do desenvolvimento, entre outras.
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames complementares (eletroencefalograma, neuroimagem, testes genéticos, etc.).
  • Prescrever medicamentos e tratamentos adequados de acordo com o diagnóstico.
  • Elaborar relatórios, laudos médicos e pareceres técnicos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento neurológico dos pacientes, realizando avaliações periódicas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com psicólogos, fonoaudiólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais, fisioterapeutas e demais profissionais.
  • Orientar familiares sobre diagnósticos, tratamentos e prognósticos.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, discussões de caso e programas de educação continuada.

  • Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.
  • Residência médica em Pediatria.
  • Residência ou especialização em Neurologia Pediátrica.
  • Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Essa vaga é para atuação sênior com foco em contencioso judicial e administrativo e em matérias regulatórias (SUSEP), envolvendo a gestão estratégica de processos, interface com escritórios externos, análise de riscos, estratégias de defesa, controle de prazos e acompanhamento de provisões e contingências. Responsável também pelo suporte ao cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias, interpretação de normas do mercado de seguros e resseguros, elaboração de respostas a demandas regulatórias e interação com áreas internas para mitigação de riscos legais. Formação Bacharelado completo em Direito, OAB ativa. Desejável pós-graduação relacionada ao Direito Civil, Direito Securitário ou Contratos Experiência Experiência sólida, perfil proativo, analítico e dinâmico, para atuação no departamento jurídico, com foco prioritário em contencioso judicial e administrativo e em matérias regulatórias. A posição envolve a condução e o acompanhamento estratégico do contencioso, incluindo a interação com escritórios externos, a análise de riscos e provisões, a elaboração de manifestações, bem como o controle rigoroso de prazos. Abrange ainda a atuação no suporte ao cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias, com especial atenção às demandas perante a SUSEP. De forma residual, o(a) profissional poderá prestar apoio na análise e elaboração de contratos, na resposta a consultas jurídicas internas e no suporte jurídico a projetos específicos das companhias do Grupo Austral. Atividades Atuação no contencioso administrativo e judicial, incluindo: acompanhamento dos processos;
interface com escritórios externos;
análise jurídica das demandas, riscos envolvidos e cenários processuais;
apoio na definição e revisão de estratégias de defesa;
acompanhamento e validação de provisões, contingências e valores envolvidos nos processos. controle e cumprimento de prazos. Prestar suporte jurídico em matérias regulatórias (SUSEP), incluindo: apoio no cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias periódicas e eventuais;
análise e interpretação de normas aplicáveis ao mercado de seguros e resseguros;
suporte na elaboraçãode respostas a ofícios, consultas e demandas regulatórias;
interação com áreas internas para alinhamento regulatório e mitigação de riscos. Atuar como ponto focal jurídico em temas de contencioso e regulatório, aplicando conhecimento técnico e visão crítica, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos legais e regulatórios da companhia. De forma residual, prestar apoio em atividades não centrais à posição, tais como: análise e elaboração de contratos e documentos jurídicos;
suporte jurídico a projetos específicos das companhias do Grupo Austral, em interface com outras áreas.

title: Cfd Consultant, Lead
description:
Lead CFD & Process Safety Consultant

The Lead CFD & Process Safety Consultant will successfully deliver projects for clients as a member of project teams within a market program. This includes supporting the project manager by leading teams initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, controlling deliver high-impact technical projects across Brazil and global markets, supporting clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen doing advanced technical analysis, practical risk-based engineering judgment, direct client engagement and leadership in project delivery.

What You Will Do

The Lead manages small teams to work on project tasks under the supervision of a project manager to ensure quality services are delivered on schedule and within the available budget to meet customer requirements.

  • Assist the project manager with defining and sequencing project tasks, estimating task duration, and developing a project schedule as part of developing a project management plan.
  • Fire and explosion modelling.
  • Gas detector allocation.
  • Flame detector allocation.
  • Exhaust and ventilation dispersion.
  • Smoke and gas dispersion.
  • Flare radiation analysis.
  • Helideck turbulence studies.
  • Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Review project management plans to understand the scope, schedule, and assigned work authorization.
  • Planning and scheduling client meetings
  • Lead client and tasks-team meetings
  • Lead small task teams with the execution of project tasks.
  • Assist with research and data analysis, including but not limited to assisting with conducting customer or stakeholder analyses.
  • Prepare written documents, reports, and presentations.
  • Develop conclusions and recommendations, write reports, and assist with client presentations.
  • Give oral presentations to clients.
  • Tracking and reporting hours spent executing projects.
  • Work with individuals at all levels, provide input to reports and other deliverables, execute multiple assignments, meet agreed deadlines, and adjust to changing client demands.
  • Performing quality assurance on project deliverables
  • Develop relationships with existing customers to facilitate the development of new business.
  • Identify new business opportunities with existing customers for current and/or additional services.
What You Will Need
  • 2-4 years of professional experience is the minimum required.
  • Degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety.
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English.
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment.
  • FLACS.
  • KFX.
  • Ansys Fluent.
  • Ansys CFX.
  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field.
  • Experience in QRA, vulnerability analysis, PHAST, and/or SAFETI.
  • Knowledge of Human Factors, including:
    • Human Reliability Analysis (HRA)
    • Human Factors Engineering (HFE)
  • Familiarity with Petro-HRA.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulations and industry requirements, including Petrobras guidelines, ANP requirements, and applicable NRs.
  • Experience across upstream, downstream, and midstream.
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other programming/automation tools.
  • Interest in digitalization and technical innovation.
  • Spanish language skills desirable.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Delegation skills.
  • Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Perform research and provide analysis on research performed.
  • Gather and analyze data effectively.
  • Apply critical thinking to a wide variety of problems.
  • Comprehend and analyze complex problems.
  • Work under tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, safety, quality, and environmental management systems.
Reporting Relationships

Could report to the Project Manager or Program Manager or a more senior level Consultant.

Equal Opportunity

The ABS Group of Companies is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

title: Analista / Consultor(A) Oracle Ebs Financials (Fa) — Pis/Cofins
description: Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS Sobre a oportunidade Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal. Principais responsabilidades Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes. Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação. Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas. Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento. Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente. Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais. Diferenciais desejáveis Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP. Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas. Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle. Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Sales Ai Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder Role Overview: You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows;
you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Key Responsibilities: - Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
- Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.
- Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.
- CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention. Qualifications: - Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.
- AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.G., 11x, Regie.Ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.
- Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Analista Contract Manager Ii
description:

title: Analista De Treinamento Júnior
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Serviços de apoio técnico e suporte especializado em atividades laboratoriais para pesquisa aplicada à exploração, produção e refino de petróleo. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Registro e controle de custódia de amostras laboratoriais e suas subamostras;
Suportar e realizar a demanda de ensaios de química analítica e correlatos: realizar protocolo de implantação, validação, execução de análises e desenvolvimento de método analítico na área química em Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC), com detectores UV, fluorescência, IR, ELSD e Espectrômetro de Massas (baixa e alta resoluções), Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID), Cromatografia de Camada Fina (TLC-FID), Cromatografias Preparativas e Extrações em Fase Sólida, Cromatografia de Permeação em Gel (GPC), além de qualquer técnica cromatográfica ou técnica analítica instrumental que possa ser necessária para os atendimentos;
Realizar análise de petróleo e derivados como: diesel, nafta, gasóleos e lubrificantes, dentre outras matrizes, avaliar consistência dos dados, emitir laudos de análise, especificar tecnicamente e encaminhar solicitações de compras de equipamentos e insumos em atendimento às exigências da legislação vigente e de forma a garantir a confiabilidade analítica do laboratório;
Preparo e análise dealíquotas de amostras de produtos (material de referência) e padrões de referência, bem como suas análises, para o Controle Estatístico de Processos (CEP) dos serviços de Análises por Cromatografia Líquida – construção de curvas de calibração, validação de equipamentos e métodos analíticos;
Construção, execuçãoe manutenção de ferramentas de controle e garantia da qualidade de resultados analíticos (cartas de controle, curvas de calibração, controle de padrões certificados etc.), bem como quaisquer ações necessárias para viabilizar a gestão da qualidade;
Preparo de amostras (pesagem, centrifugação, precipitação, filtração, extração com solventes, extração em fase sólida e quaisquer outras operações unitárias necessárias para adequação da amostra original ao método analítico instrumental que suportará o atendimento solicitado, não exclusivo a métodos cromatográficos);
Fracionamento e análise de amostras orgânicas por cromatografia líquida (MPLC, HPLC e preparativa/gravimétrica);
Aferição das vidrarias de precisão, no ato do recebimento ou sob demanda específica;
Alimentação debases de dados por uso de softwares de aplicação à laboratórios de análises químicas;
Manutenção básica operacional de Cromatógrafos e outros equipamentos analíticos, configuração básica de hardware e software;
Solicitar e acompanhar manutenção das instalações, equipamentos e fornecimento de consumíveis;
Gestão das amostras no laboratório, incluindo recebimento, aceitação e armazenamento adequado das amostras, cadastro de amostras, solicitação de ensaios, emissão de resultados, devolução de amostras já concluídas no sistema de gerenciamento de informações de laboratório (LIMS) vigente;
Gestão e controle deestoque e orçamentação de insumos (reagentes, padrões etc.), peças e equipamentos laboratoriais;
Coordenação, execução, atualização e confecção de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrões pertinentes às rotinas laboratoriais;
Coordenação e execução de descartes de resíduos laboratoriais;
Zelar, executar e garantir o cumprimento das normas e requisitos de segurança do laboratório e liberação de serviços no local;
Coordenação detreinamentos necessários para capacitação de técnicos na execução das análises e metodologias analíticas por Cromatografia Líquida;
Realizar visitas técnicas externas para acompanhamento e execução de serviços ou incorporação de tecnologias;
Otimização dosrecursos e infraestrutura laboratoriais para produção analítica;
Dominar ferramentas de suporte ao processamento dos dados, compilação e apresentação de resultados, como: MS Office, Chemstation/EZChrom (OpenLab);
Emissão de relatórios e/ou laudos (certificados) de análise em português e/ou Inglês;
Demais atividades necessárias à execução dos serviços acima mencionados. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Formação: Graduação Completa em Química. Experiência: Vivência mínima de 6 anos em cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência ou 5 anos de vivência em alguma das técnicas abaixo: 1.Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC);
2.Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID);
3.Cromatografia em Camada Fina (TLC-FID);
4.Cromatografia de Permeação em Gel (GPC). Conhecimentos Obrigatórios: Conhecimento em análise e processamento por cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência ou em alguma das técnicas: Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC), Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID), Cromatografia em Camada Fina (TLC-FID) e Cromatografia de Permeação em Gel (GPC);
Domínio do Pacote Office;
Nível intermediário (leitura e escrita) da Língua Inglesa. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION BEM-VINDO(A) AO MUNDO INFOTEC! Nós somos uma empresa especializada em Terceirização de Serviços e Processos, atuamos há 35 anos no mercado de outsourcing de serviços, processos e pessoas. Nossos serviços permitem que os clientes mantenham foco nas principais estratégias de negócio enquanto promovemos eficiência operacional, por meio da otimização de processos e redução de custos, com o uso de recursos tecnológicos, baixo absenteísmo, menor risco trabalhista, cuidados ambientais e muito mais. title: Técnico Em Segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. - Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor’s degree;
- Desirable: Experience with eSocial system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting). Benefits we offer: - Food allowance;
- Transportationallowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- WellHub Membership. If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now. All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Banco De Talentos
description:
Somos a JTI - Japan Tobacco International - e acreditamos na liberdade. Acreditamos que as possibilidades são infinitas quando você é livre para escolher. Mas nosso negócio não é apenas negócio. Nosso negócio é nossa gente. Seus talentos. Seus potenciais. Acreditamos que quando nossas pessoas são livres para serem elas mesmas, para crescerem, inovarem e se desenvolverem, coisas incríveis acontecem para o nosso negócio. Então, se você não quer se encaixar, a JTI é para você. Claro, o trabalho é importante, mas na JTI a família e nossas relações vem em primeiro lugar. Nós apoiamos você, enquanto você trabalha, para você poder apoiar as pessoas que importam. É por isso que nossos colaboradores, de todo o mundo, optam por fazer parte da JTI. É por isso que 9 em cada 10 nos recomendariam a um amigo. É por isso que fomos certificados globalmente como uma empresa Top Employer por sete anos consecutivos. Conhecimento de obrigações fiscais e emissão de NFS-e (Nota Fiscal de Serviços Eletrônica);
Perfil analítico,orientado a dados e com forte capacidade de priorização;
Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de AI. Não é obrigatório, mas vamos curtir se você tiver: Experiência em empresas de conteúdo, entretenimento, mídia ou marketing;
Vivência com implantação de processos ou sistemas financeiros do zero. #Importante A Play9 repudia qualquer discriminação de indivíduos seja por raça, classe social, etnia, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, idade ou qualquer outra condição. Muito boa sorte! ⚡

description: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil Share We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately. title: Analista De Logística, Ats - Middle Mile
description:
About Turing: Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German) Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Director
description:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference. We are seeking a Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil to provide scientific and regulatory leadership across one of our most strategically important markets. This role is pivotal in protecting and expanding the Company’s freedom to operate by ensuring portfolio compliance, enabling innovation, and actively shaping the external regulatory environment through science‑based advocacy. The ideal candidate will bring deep scientific expertise, strong regulatory judgment, and the ability to influence policy and business decisions through credibility and collaboration. If you are passionate about science‑led advocacy, regulatory leadership, and enabling responsible growth, we want you on our team. What You’ll Do For Us Lead the execution of the Scientific & Regulatory Affairs agenda for Brazil, aligning scientific, regulatory, and advocacy activities with business priorities and regional and global SRA direction. Engage in science‑based regulatory advocacy, contributing technical expertise and evidence to help shape policies, standards, and guidance that impact the Company’s portfolio and future innovation. Serve as the scientific and regulatory authority for claims and marketing communications evaluation and approval, ensuring compliance, credibility, and appropriate substantiation. Ensure compliance continuity across the full portfolio after product launch. Partner closely with Marketing, R&D, Legal, Public Affairs, and Franchise teams to anticipate regulatory risks and enable compliant, timely business decisions. Monitor and assess emerging scientific, regulatory, and public policy trends, translating complexity into clear implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Requirements & Qualifications Advanced degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline. 10+ years of experience in scientific and/or regulatory affairs within food, beverage, consumer goods, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated industries. Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory frameworks, with demonstrated experience engaging with ANVISA and other relevant authorities. Proven expertise in regulatory advocacy, claims substantiation, labeling, marketing communications review, and product compliance across the product life cycle. Ability to influence cross‑functional and external stakeholders in a matrixed organization without direct people management responsibility. Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort operating in complex, evolving regulatory environments. Experience working in emerging markets and within global organizations strongly preferred. Fluent in Portuguese and English;
Spanish proficiency isa plus. Iconic Brands: Support some of the world’s most trusted and loved brands within a system grounded in science, integrity, and responsibility. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description: The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience. About Us Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic. Role This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms. As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality. Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly. Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation. Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization. Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously. The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Especialista Em Plant Simulation (Pj)
description: Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel. Principais Responsabilidades Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation. Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna. Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0). Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças. Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM). Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta. Requisitos e Qualificações O que você precisa ter (Essencial): Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas. Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation. Domínio de programação em SimTalk. Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída). Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos). O que vai te destacar (Diferencial): Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter). Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL). Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais). Contratação: PJ.

description:
Gerente de Produto Sr. Home Office | PJ Você será responsável pela visão de produto das ferramentas internas que gestores de portfólio, analistas quantitativos e traders utilizam diariamente. Não se trata de gestão de produtos para o consumidor final — seus usuários gerenciam bilhões e não têm paciência para softwares que os atrasem.\ "Um ótimo gestor de portfólioaqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\ " \"Um ótimo gestor deportfólio aqui não precisa ser um analista quantitativo. Mas precisa pensar como um investidor e falar a linguagem fluente do mercado financeiro — ou nossos usuários jamais confiarão nele.\ " \" Conhecimento da área financeira é imprescindível — não negociável - Fluxo de trabalho de investimento: Geração de ideias → pesquisa → construção de portfólio → execução → monitoramento → relatórios - Gestão de portfólio: Ações long/short, multiestratégia, estruturas de alocação, lógica de rebalanceamento, gestão de drawdown - Risco e conformidade: Limites de posição, risco de concentração, relatórios regulatórios (13F, AIFMD), padrões de relatórios para investidores - Operações de negociação: Sistemas OMS/EMS, fundamentos do protocolo FIX, verificações de conformidade pré-negociação, alocação de negociações - Atribuição de desempenho: Atribuição Brinson, decomposição de fatores, relatórios de retorno relativo ao benchmark versus retorno absoluto - Relações com investidores: Relatórios para LPs, fluxos de trabalho DDQ, fundamentos de contabilidade de fundos, processos de chamada de capital/distribuição Habilidades - Mais de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de produtos — com pelo menos 3 anos em serviços financeiros, gestão de ativos ou fintech atendendo clientes institucionais - Você já desenvolveu produtos para investidores profissionais, traders ou gestores de portfólio — não para o varejo - Capacidade de ler e discutir um relatório de atribuição de fatores Análise detalhada de lucros e perdas ou resumo da exposição ao risco sem glossário - Experiência com fornecedores de OMS/EMS (Charles River, Advent, Eze ou equivalentes) - Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar roteiros em ambientes altamente regulamentados e sujeitos a auditorias - Forte intuição para dados — você consegue escrever SQL e consultar um modelo de dados de forma independente - MBA ou CFA são um diferencial;

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description: About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices. About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains. This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth. What You’ll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil. What You’ll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions. Position Overview As a Backend Team Lead, you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Overseas Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings. Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company. Bring your talent to SWM! We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro. Position Objective Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs. Your challenges will include: 1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth. Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage. Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency. 2. Market Intelligence & Analysis Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks. Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance. Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making. 3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met. Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans. Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility 4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning. EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines. Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities What we’re looking for: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;

Languages: Fluency in English, any other language is a plus Availability to travel. description:

Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. - Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

- Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.
- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

- Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.
- Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

- Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer - Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments. Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:

The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link.
